narrative.overview: A compact confidence monitor built into studio hardware, with matte graphite planes, warm reading text, restrained controls, and a scarce live-red signal.
keyCharacteristics: Matte graphite surfaces separated by tone and one-pixel rules.
Warm-white reading text against near-black prompt fields.
Live red reserved for playback-critical state and action.
Native typography with monospaced digits limited to measurements.
A split editor workspace paired with a notch-aligned confidence monitor.
Immediate pause and reduced-motion-safe state changes.

rules.name: The Live Red Rule
rules.body: Reserve Live Red for primary playback, live or countdown state, progress, and the reading guide.

rules.name: The Warm Legibility Rule
rules.body: Reading content and primary labels use Warm Reading White; Studio Gray is secondary only.

rules.name: The Utility Mono Rule
rules.body: Monospaced figures belong only to timing and measurement.

rules.name: The Prompt Owns the Scale Rule
rules.body: Prompt copy and countdown digits own the largest type.

rules.name: The Camera Axis Rule
rules.body: Prompt text, countdown numerals, and reading guide stay centered on the notch or fallback axis.

rules.name: The Working Split Rule
rules.body: The first editor view preserves both the script workspace and preview/control rail.

rules.name: The Matte Layer Rule
rules.body: Use graphite tone changes and one-pixel separators, not gradients, glow, or decorative translucency.

rules.name: The Native Shadow Rule
rules.body: Reserve elevation for the operating-system panel shadow.

rules.name: The Posture Radius Rule
rules.body: The panel becomes more rounded as it expands.
